seiyuuResume.title: Résumé Spotter
seiyuuResume.intro: A profile card with planted mistakes - tap the tampered rows before the clock runs out.
seiyuuResume.rule1: Each card hides 1-3 mistakes among agency, project, signature role or romanisation.
seiyuuResume.rule2: Wrong taps cost you: blaming a correct row hurts more than missing a wrong one.
seiyuuResume.rule3: Submit before time is up - faster pays more, and a clean sweep earns a time bonus.
seiyuuResume.pickHint: This card hides {{count}} mistake(s) - tap the rows to mark them.

verdict.perfect: All found - not one too many, not one too few.

comment.S: No profile card gets past you - you know the details better than the official site.
comment.A: You caught almost every planted mistake.
comment.B: You know the faces; the fine print still needs work.
comment.C: Memorise a few favourites first, then come back.
